text: Had the writer's money been stolen?
I entered the hotel manager's office and sat down.
zh: 我走进酒店经理的办公室，坐了下来。
zh_hant: 我走進酒店經理的辦公室，坐了下來。

text: I had just lost ￡50 and I felt very upset.
zh: 我刚才丢了50英镑，感到非常不安。
zh_hant: 我剛才丟了50英鎊，感到非常不安。

text: 'I left the money in my room,'
I said, 'and it's not there now.
' The manager was sympathetic, but he could do nothing.
zh: 经理表示同情，但他也无能为力。
zh_hant: 經理表示同情，但他也無能為力。

text: 'Everyone's losing money these days,' he said.
He started to complain about this wicked world
zh: 他开始抱怨这个邪恶的世界
zh_hant: 他開始抱怨這個邪惡的世界

text: but was interrupted by a knock at the door.
A girl came in and put an envelope on his desk.
zh: 一个女孩走了进来，把一个信封放在他的桌上。
zh_hant: 一個女孩走了進來，把一個信封放在他的桌上。

text: 'I found this outside this gentleman's room,' she said.
zh: “我在这位先生房间外面捡到的，”她说。
zh_hant: “我在這位先生房間外面撿到的，”她說。

text: is still some honesty in this world!'
